opening.argument: The session identifies itself as instruction for online classes and lectures, and the presenter explains how educators can create and manage a class team. The demonstrated workflow continues with organizing course material through a channel named “Week 1 Entrepreneurship,” while the visible Microsoft Teams dialog shows that channel being created for a Business Studies team. These are ordinary classroom-setup and software-organization steps. References to joining classes, sharing materials, meeting links, webinar resources, and Teams functionality therefore describe educational participation and operational use of the platform, not a financial offer or a request for payment, credentials, or investment.

citations.quote: Online classes and lectures with all your students. Part 1 class setup
